entries.name: The household in the west shed

norms.text: Mats are patched with reed from the store before the rains.

taboos.text: Speaking for the clutch as if it were their own.

values.text: A dry mat and a full water jar.

contempts.text: Being counted as Argonian kin by the ledger and as strangers by the shed.

addressTerms.text: Walker, the same as the camp, said with a Khajiit's warmth.

grievances.text: They carry water for a Hist that will never name them.
